endpoints.name: search_events
endpoints.label: 🔍 Search Calendar Events
endpoints.description: Search calendar events using a keyword.

path_params.calendarId: The calendar identifier (e.g. 'primary' or a calendar ID string).

query_params.q: Free‑text search terms to filter events (string, required).

endpoints.name: list_upcoming_events
endpoints.label: 📆 List Upcoming Events
endpoints.description: List upcoming calendar events ordered by start time.

path_params.calendarId: The calendar identifier (e.g. 'primary' or a calendar ID string).

query_params.orderBy: Sort order for events (e.g. 'startTime', string, optional).
query_params.singleEvents: Whether to expand recurring events into instances (boolean, optional).
query_params.timeMin: RFC3339 timestamp to only return events after this time (string, optional).
query_params.maxResults: Maximum number of events to return (integer, optional).

endpoints.name: create_event
endpoints.label: 🗓️ Create Calendar Event
endpoints.description: Create a new event in the user's calendar.

path_params.calendarId: The calendar identifier (e.g. 'primary' or a calendar ID string).

body_params.summary: Title or summary of the event (string, required).
body_params.attendees: Array of attendee objects, each with an 'email' field (array of { email: string }, optional).

path_params.calendarId: The calendar identifier (e.g. 'primary' or a calendar ID string).
path_params.eventId: The identifier of the event to delete.

endpoints.name: update_event
endpoints.label: ✏️ Update Calendar Event
endpoints.description: Update details of a calendar event.

path_params.calendarId: The calendar identifier (e.g. 'primary' or a calendar ID string).
path_params.eventId: The identifier of the event to update.

body_params.summary: Updated title or summary of the event (string, optional).
body_params.start: Updated start object with 'dateTime' (RFC3339 string) and 'timeZone' (string, optional).
body_params.end: Updated end object with 'dateTime' (RFC3339 string) and 'timeZone' (string, optional).
